definitions.gloss: disaster preparedness supplies; emergency supplies; disaster kit
definitions.explanation: Items kept on hand in preparation for natural disasters such as earthquakes, typhoons, and floods. Includes food, water, flashlights, first-aid kits, batteries, and other survival essentials. A culturally important concept in disaster-prone Japan.

examples.japanese: {防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧おこう。
{防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}っています→売る：00906_uru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Where can I buy disaster preparedness supplies?

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, more people reviewed their disaster supplies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{全員分|ぜんいんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リュック→リュック：04541_ryukku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめてある→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I've packed disaster supplies for the whole family into one backpack.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧ (disaster prevention/preparedness) and ⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧ (goods, items — from English). This is the standard everyday term for the emergency supplies that many Japanese households keep ready.

Japan's frequent earthquakes, typhoons, and other natural disasters make {防災|ぼうさい}グッズ a familiar concept in daily life. Home centers, convenience stores, and online shops sell pre-assembled kits, and September 1 (⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧, Disaster Prevention Day) is a common time for people to check and refresh their supplies.

Typical items include ⟦{非常食|ひじょうしょく}→非常食：18765_hijoushoku⟧ (emergency food), ⟦{懐中電灯|かいちゅうでんとう}→懐中電灯：05479_kaichuudentou⟧ (flashlight), ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧ (portable radio), ⟦{飲料水|いんりょうすい}→飲料水：15275_inryousui⟧ (drinking water), and ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (first-aid kit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧: to prepare emergency supplies
- {防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to review/update one's disaster supplies
- {防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to assemble disaster supplies
- {防災|ぼうさい}グッズ⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧: a full set of emergency supplies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {非常持|ひじょうも}ち{出|だ}し{袋|ぶくろ}: emergency go-bag — the bag itself for evacuating with essential supplies
- ⟦{備蓄品|びちくひん}→備蓄品：25631_bichikuhin⟧: stockpiled supplies — a more formal term for stored provisions
- ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: disaster preparedness set — a near-synonym, emphasizing a pre-packaged kit
